project: classattendance.in - AI, Machine Learning & Analytics Layer
scope: ai_pipeline only; staging development, separate production release

tasks.title: Inspect core interfaces and apply isolated pipeline schema
tasks.description: Verify the canonical attendance and AI job interfaces and schema. Apply database/migration_ai_analytics.sql only to the assigned pre-provisioned disposable database. Document discovered engine/version and incompatible legacy tables in ai_pipeline/database/SCHEMA_NOTES.md. Never change production schema, provider rows, feature flags or consent.
acceptance_criteria: All required core columns and v2 analytics columns/unique keys verified in the isolated database.
Migration applied twice without changing existing provider/module/consent settings; record the evidence.

tasks.title: Validate Windows environment and configured local model
tasks.description: Verify Python 3.10+, explicit PHP path, isolated DB connection and exact configured Ollama model. Use standard-library Python; do not install unused ML packages. Document Windows account, service startup and actual CLI invocation smoke test in ai_pipeline/WINDOWS_VALIDATION.md.
acceptance_criteria: Missing database, Ollama or configured model returns nonzero.
Windows scheduled-task account can run the configured CLI headlessly; document actual installed versions.

tasks.title: Validate policy-aware attendance snapshots
tasks.description: Use worker/attendance_batch.php through the Python compatibility entry point. Create an isolated fixture test tests/test_attendance_staging.php for joins, class scope, late joining, enrollment, permissions, missing diary evidence and configurable thresholds. No learned model or probability claims. Test duplicate-safe snapshots and rollback on failure.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshots match College\AttendanceService, including DATA_UNAVAILABLE and POLICY_REVIEW.
Dry runs do not write; repeat writes are idempotent and transaction failures roll back.

tasks.title: Validate existing AI worker without live jobs
tasks.description: Create tests/test_ai_jobs_staging.php using isolated fixtures and fake provider transport. Reuse existing AIJobService and AIProvider. Verify consent, module controls, duplicate input, job lease/retry, output validation and scoped approval. Do not use a production worker invocation as a test.
acceptance_criteria: Consent revocation, disabled module/provider and unauthorized review prevent side effects.
Mocked output reaches DRAFT once; retries and lease recovery are covered without external AI calls.

tasks.title: Implement optional feedback analysis against verified evidence
tasks.description: First inspect actual feedback tables/columns and whether free-text comments exist. If absent or no explicit consent/privacy contract exists, report BLOCKED with the needed prerequisite. Otherwise create worker/feedback_analyzer.py and isolated tests/test_feedback_staging.php. Use de-identified bounded evidence, validated JSON, source hashes, timeouts and DRAFT reports; no direct faculty ranking or publication.
acceptance_criteria: Verified source/consent contract, de-identification and prompt-injection handling tested.
Malformed output/failures do not publish reports; duplicate evidence is idempotent.

tasks.title: Prepare authorized CQI draft requests using existing service
tasks.description: Create an ai_pipeline-only adapter and tests/test_cqi_staging.php using existing evidence snapshots and AIJobService.queueSubject in the authorized user context. Use ATTAINMENT_ANALYSIS or ATR_PROPOSAL; do not insert invented CO_CQI_ACTION jobs, fabricate curriculum columns, bypass consent or automatically approve CQI actions.
acceptance_criteria: Only an authorized, opted-in owner can queue reviewed evidence; no cross-owner impersonation.
Existing input/provider hashes deduplicate jobs and output remains subject to human review.

tasks.title: Validate scoped snapshot helper and document portal integration
tasks.description: Complete api/risk_service.php tests in tests/test_risk_staging.php for student/faculty/HOD scope, changed policy, old class, stale cache and unavailable schema. Add INTEGRATION.md with include examples for authorized portal callers. Do not edit portal files outside ai_pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthorized access is rejected; stale/mismatched policy/class snapshots are not displayed.
Badges retain provisional categories and dynamic targets; integration changes outside ai_pipeline remain a separate release.

tasks.title: Audit staging batch, scheduling and recovery
tasks.description: Create tests/test_end_to_end_staging.php for isolated pipeline behavior. Verify the Windows wrappers return failures, single-run locking, interrupted-run recovery, bounded execution, external runtime privacy, migration backup/rollback instructions and nightly batch opt-in. Record real Windows tests in WINDOWS_VALIDATION.md. Do not call syntax checks a complete end-to-end audit.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end staging tests and a real Windows scheduled invocation pass; document timestamps/evidence.
Recovery, backups, deployment and rollback are documented without enabling production processing.
